verdicts.title: On the rational subsets of the monogenic free inverse monoid
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We prove that the equality problem is decidable for rational subsets of the monogenic free inverse monoid $F$. It is also decidable whether or not a rational subset of $F$ is recognizable. We prove that a submonoid of $F$ is rational if and only if it is finitely generated. We also prove that the membership problem for rational subsets of a finite $\mathcal{J}$-above monoid is decidable, covering the case of free inverse monoids.

verdicts.title: The representation theory of the monoid of all partial functions on a set and related monoids as EI-category algebras
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The (ordinary) quiver of an algebra $A$ is a graph that contains information about the algebra's representations. We give a description of the quiver of $\mathbb{C}PT_{n}$, the algebra of the monoid of all partial functions on $n$ elements. verdicts.title: Ideal class groups of monoid algebras
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let $A\subset B$ be an extension of commutative reduced rings and $M\subset N$ an extension of positive commutative cancellative torsion-free monoids. We prove that $A$ is subintegrally closed in $B$ and $M$ is subintegrally closed in $N$ if and only if the group of invertible $A$-submodules of $B$ is isomorphic to the group of invertible $A[M]$-submodules of $B[N]$. In case $M=N$, we prove the same without the assumption that the ring extension is reduced.
